text: The kind invokes the comm Flatpak transform after release dependencies and before localization packaging. Its format pass resolves keyed environment values before formatting them with release_config, config_params and the current task. Its desktop-file pass inspects only selected repackage dependencies before adding a task-reference URL. The original copy uses older gecko_taskgraph imports and release_level(project); fixed accepted code uses mozilla_taskgraph and release_level(release-branches, params), and adds flatpak_name. Keep historical signatures separate from the checked current input contract. The absent-DESKTOP_FILE_URL assert has no message. No upstream helper body, taskgraph generation, artifact fetch or package execution was validated.
title: The comm Flatpak transform formats worker inputs before it builds the desktop artifact reference
